Processor A returned AUTH for small test amounts (e.g., USD 49) but failed at capture for the full amount. Processor B historically has a higher acceptance for this issuer when SCA is required.

My recommended execution:
- Attempt a split capture: 50% (9,200) immediate auth + 50% scheduled for 48h window. This often bypasses limits set by some issuers for single large authorizations.

- If the split capture succeeds, we’ll mark the invoice partially collected and schedule automated follow-up for the remainder.
